# tokens: # ADR-012 sugar markers (2026-08-04 amendment): the parser emits
# structural Word/__SG markers for every surface sugar — it never
# invents a word name. Stepping a marker resolves its ROLE through the
# registry's sugar-word table (bindSugarWord); the BARE KERNEL binds
# nothing, so every sugar surface refuses loudly with sugar_unbound
# instead of silently dispatching an invented name. These rows pin that
# refusal contract in BOTH engines (the language layer, which binds the
# roles, proves the positive path in lang/spec/generics-sugar.tsv and
# friends). The parse-level stream shapes are pinned by the stream

note: the => lambda marker steps with no bound lambda role
the arrow folds after a paren group and still refuses unbound
a minilang literal is ONE mini marker; no mini role bound
an angle use-site marker refuses without the gen-apply role
the X/t bounded-type sugar refuses without gen-apply
the /u group modifier is a usurp marker; no usurp role bound
the /N group modifier is a force-arity marker; no role bound
